facts.raw_span: A 40-year-old woman presented with abdominal pain and constipation
continued to have amenorrhea and reported abdominal fullness and constipation
Point-of-care (POC) urine human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) test: negative
Ultrasonography: Confirmed live intrauterine pregnancy at 24 weeks

support_spans: Point-of-care (POC) urine human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) test: negative
Ultrasonography: Confirmed live intrauterine pregnancy at 24 weeks
concepts.why: The patient had a negative point-of-care urine hCG test, but a high serum hCG level and a confirmed live intrauterine pregnancy, suggesting a heterotopic pregnancy.

contradict_spans: Ultrasonography: Confirmed live intrauterine pregnancy at 24 weeks
concepts.why: The high serum hCG level could suggest a molar pregnancy, but the confirmed live intrauterine pregnancy makes this less likely.
The undetectable thyroid-stimulating hormone level could suggest a thyroid storm, but the unremarkable vital signs make this less likely.
The patient's history of thyroid condition and undetectable thyroid-stimulating hormone level could suggest Graves' disease.

support_spans: Ultrasonography: Confirmed live intrauterine pregnancy at 24 weeks
concepts.why: The patient's history of thyroid condition and confirmed pregnancy could suggest pregnancy with hyperthyroidism.

rationales.F08: A tender midline abdominal mass is more likely to be associated with a pregnancy-related condition.
rationales.F09: A negative point-of-care urine hCG test decreases the likelihood of pregnancy, but this is contradicted by later tests.
rationales.F10: A high serum hCG level is strongly indicative of pregnancy.
rationales.F11: Ultrasonography confirming a live intrauterine pregnancy at 24 weeks rules out other conditions like molar pregnancy or heterotopic pregnancy.

frontier_selector.why: The combination of a confirmed live intrauterine pregnancy, significantly elevated serum hCG levels, and a history of thyroid condition with undetectable thyroid-stimulating hormone decided it.
